resources.string: A sandbox: place pieces anywhere, press play and watch everything react
Drag with one finger to move around, two to zoom. Pick a piece, tap the board to place it.
Fixed sloped plank. It guides the ball where it falls.
Fixed bouncy peg. The ball leaves at an angle.
Fixed wall. It blocks, or sends back.
Falls when pushed, and pushes the next one.
Fixed foot, free plank. Drag either end: the foot becomes the pivot of a lever.
Spring-loaded flap. What lands on it is thrown forward.
Blows a jet of air. Drag the far handle to set its power. Linked to a plate, it only blows while the plate is on.
Taut skin. What falls on it comes back up almost as high.
Bucket and counterweight. The ball falling in raises the counterweight.
A second ball. It waits where you put it until something frees it.
Fixed belt. It carries along, flat, without losing height.
A wall torch. It lights up, and that is all it is asked to do.
Rises with its basket. Fans push it; a ball in the basket weighs it down. Resize it to change its lift.
A heavy iron ball on a rod. Drag the ball to set length and angle: it swings and strikes sideways.
Pulls iron: balls, the pendulum ball. Flip it to push instead. Drag the handle to set its strength.

Fires its ball when something touches its red button, at the back, or when a linked plate is pressed. Flip it (⇄) and it fires as soon as the machine starts. Turn it with the near handle, set its power with the far one.
A sharp point. A balloon that touches it bursts, basket included: only what it carried falls. Drag the handle to turn it.
A switch: each press toggles it, and its lamp shows whether it is on. Flip it (⇄) for a push button, on only while pressed. Select it, tap the link button, then drag to a cannon or a fan.
Drag from one item to another to link them: plate to cannon or fan. Do it again to unlink.
